property_summary: After a call to forward(callee, data), the callee's code MUST have been executed, which can be observed by using a callee that writes to a public state variable; in the mutant, no call is made so no write occurs.
change_summary: Replace the forward function body with a no-op, so it never calls the callee.
mutated_unit_code: function forward(address callee, bytes memory _data) public { }
